title: The 'association' of 24 retired officials pushing UAP programs back under government oversight

tellings.quote: There has arisen uh an insurgency group that have uh occupied extremely high positions uh in the defense department uh inside the central intelligence agency

plain: A group of 24 retired officials, a kind of "insurgency group" that once held very high posts in the Defense Department, the CIA (the US Central Intelligence Agency) and big aerospace companies, is said to be working to bring secret programs on UAP, the government's term for UFOs, back under government oversight. Dan Sheehan, a guest on an episode about missing scientists, says a man named Michael Phillip told him this. If true, it would mean insiders are pushing from within to bring these hidden programs into the light.
